title: CICIoT2023 feature-selection provenance (29-column observation basis)
_note: Machine-readable, citable record of which 29 numeric features the AdversarialIoTEnv observation is built from, and why. Resolves review item C6. The canonical source of truth is the gitignored data/processed/ciciot2023/metadata.json (feature_columns + feature_selection_info); this artifact mirrors it and pins its SHA-256 so the thesis can cite the column basis without shipping the raw CIC data.

generated_from.reason_gitignored: Derived from raw CICIoT2023 CSVs, which are not redistributable under the CIC license.

pipeline.name: zero_variance_removal
pipeline.rule: sklearn VarianceThreshold(threshold=0): drop features with literally zero variance on the train split

pipeline.name: low_variance_removal
pipeline.rule: keep features with train-split var >= variance_threshold (0.01); only applied if > 10 features survive stage 1; keyword-protected features are exempt

pipeline.name: high_correlation_removal
pipeline.rule: for each pair with |Pearson corr| > correlation_threshold (0.95) on the train split, drop the lower-variance member; keyword-protected features preferentially kept

observation_note: The 29 features are never hard-coded in the environment; AdversarialIoTEnv derives num_features from features.npy at load time (29). The production observation stacks window_size=5 frames with first-order deltas: obs_dim = 5 * 29 * 2 = 290.
